blinding_guess.why: The plugin reads its SDF configuration only through sdf::Element::HasElement, GetElement, GetParent and the templated Get<T>() accessor, and never calls the GetValueBool/GetValueDouble/GetValueString accessors; nothing in the listed API usage looks inconsistent with a hydro-era sdformat.

notes: All seven packet elements are consumed APIs; the package provides none of them, so declares and not_declared are empty. The sdf pointer is sdf::ElementPtr (header line 68); GetElement and GetParent return sdf::ElementPtr, so every Get<T>() call is sdf::Element::Get. Get is called both with a key (Get<std::string>("name") on the parent element, line 83) and without (Get<std::string>/Get<bool>/Get<double> on child elements). api:sdf::Element::GetValueBool, api:sdf::Element::GetValueDouble and api:sdf::Element::GetValueString are not referenced anywhere in the snapshot (grep for 'GetValue' over the whole snapshot returns nothing), including in comments; they are consumed-side elements and so appear in neither declares nor not_declared, and have no port. Commented-out lines 96-97 mention _sdf->HasElement/GetElement/Get<std::string>() for node_namespace but are inactive. ROS 1 package, so QoS fields are null; frame 'none' because these are SDF configuration accessors with no coordinate frame. exclusive is empty: the plugin drives wheel joints via SetVelocity/SetMaxForce (lines 447-450) but claims no resource exclusively in code or configuration. The SDF element values (joint names, publish_tf, wheel_separation, wheel_diameter, torque, velocity_command_timeout, cliff sensor names, cliff_detection_threshold, bumper_name) are supplied by a robot description outside the snapshot (robot.xml loads kobuki_description/urdf/kobuki_standalone.urdf.xacro). Recovery is recorded as the velocity-command timeout safe stop; a missing required SDF element instead makes Load log ROS_ERROR and return early. Observations outside the listed elements, not investigated: Load returns early when publish_tf is absent although the log says only 'Won't publish tf' (line 166); the error message for velocity_command_timeout refers to wheel separation (line 209); sensor_msgs is used (header line 116, cpp line 39) but not listed in package.xml; odom_pose_ is never initialised; max_floot_dist_ is an int holding float ranges.
